_meta.description: Stage 1 (Registered) for the Anaplan Platform foundational journey. Required for Delivery and Pre-Sales personas (technical roles). Adds Anaplan Overview as prereq — completion of the universal foundation comes first.
_meta._audience_note: Required for Delivery (configures models on customer engagements) and Pre-Sales (drives demo environments). Sales persona does not enroll in this journey.

_note: Stage 1 task structure for the Anaplan Platform foundational journey.
name: Registered
description: Resource confirms journey understanding, partner portal access, technical-resource profile, Partner Success engagement model, and Anaplan Overview prereq completion.

tasks.title: Review Anaplan Platform Journey roadmap & expectations
tasks.description: Walk through the 3 stages of the Anaplan Platform journey, what's covered in each, the certification exam at Stage 3 exit, and how this foundational journey routes to per-application Delivery or Pre-Sales journeys on completion.

tasks.title: Complete technical-resource profile
tasks.description: Augment the resource profile with technical specialization fields: prior modeling experience (other platforms), prior Anaplan exposure (workspace user, end-user, model builder), preferred specialization (Modeler / UX / Integrations / Admin), and intended persona pathway (Delivery / Pre-Sales). Manager attestation required to exit Stage 2.

tasks.title: Re-confirm Anaplan Partner Success engagement model
tasks.description: Quick re-confirmation of the Partner Success engagement model from Anaplan Overview — relevant here because technical roles have specific support paths (Anapedia, Community, Partner Engineering escalation). Resource acknowledges familiarity.

gates.description: Anaplan Platform Journey roadmap reviewed and acknowledged

_stage_exit_actions_note: No system-side actions on Stage 1 exit. Sandbox provisioning for hands-on labs fires within Stage 2.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Light Stage 1 — mostly carryover from Anaplan Overview completion.
